cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You're selling the sofa but keeping my chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody offered anything for it. Have you brought its cushion back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. If someone offered twenty pounds, would you still keep it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I like pretending you're about to sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll admit I sleep with the cushion. Could you take the price sticker off before I sit?

mechanism: A withholds return of a chair cushion until B admits the attachment behind keeping the chair, then grants reciprocal confession and sitting.
confusable: D83 tests memory; D88 tests attachment before risking A own admission.
comparison: A sale object and cushion differ from explicit longing after a return to a shared flat.
seedUse: Use D88-b no-offer explanation and hypothetical price; make withholding and release of the cushion part of A superior control.
